issues.description: Field mismatch for Genre.name: The problem statement requires Genre to have a name (String) field that the Client prints. The solution declares the field as a private property ('private let name: String') in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift, but the client code in Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift accesses genre.name when printing the inventory. Declaring the property private prevents Client from reading it and will cause a compilation error, contradicting the problem specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Genre.name property accessible to the Client. Remove the 'private' modifier and declare the property as internal (default) or public depending on intended visibility. For example: change 'private let name: String' to 'let name: String' in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift so Client can read genre.name when printing the inventory.
